headline: The Alejandro Mario Yllanes Paintings Saved From a Dumpster
context: Alejandro Mario Yllanes, a self-taught Bolivian painter, made searingly political works championed by Diego Rivera. Their journey to major museums is a 50-year saga full of mysteries.
